generatedFrom.note: Images are from the tagged build of sha (1824883286a). Source refs are path:line (Type.member) at sourceRefsSha; the symbol is the stable anchor when lines drift. Colors are formulas over the terminal theme; the resolved tables under themes.* are computed by tools/derive_theme_tokens.py, a line-for-line port of ThemeTokens.derive, and spot-checked against screenshots.

conventions.units: pt = macOS points (1 CSS px at devicePixelRatio 1; screenshots are 2x). Times in seconds.
conventions.colorRefs: token:<name> is a ThemeTokens field. alpha(token:x, a) replaces alpha. mix(a, b, t) = a + (b-a)*t per sRGB channel (ThemeRGB.mixed). over(fill, surface) = source-over compositing.
conventions.density: Every metric has compact and comfortable values. Default density is compact (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/DesignSettings.swift:25 (DesignSettings.density)). appearance.density in cmux.json switches it.
conventions.pixelSnapping: Strip and pill offsets snap to device pixels: snap(v)=round(v*scale)/scale, snapDown(v)=floor(v*scale+0.0001)/scale (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/PaneChromeMetrics.swift:69-77 (PaneChromeMetrics.snap)). Hairlines are 1/scale pt (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextLayout/Geometry/PaneChromeGeometry.swift:62 (PaneChromeGeometry.hairlineWidth)).
conventions.corners: Two corner shapes. Continuous (cornerCurve .continuous): tab pills, tab close and new-tab buttons, sidebar rows and the selection pill, omnibar, tab group bands. Circular arcs: pane clips, pane borders, focus and attention rings and the inactive dim (circular on purpose so the browser page mask matches; Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextLayout/Views/PaneHostView.swift:128-131 (PaneClipView)), palette rows, keycaps and the palette actions menu (NSBezierPath roundedRect; Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextPalette/PaletteRowCell.swift:41,67 (PaletteKeycapsView.draw, PaletteTableRowView.drawBackground)). Ports draw each surface with the shape listed for it.
conventions.noBlue: No accent hue. Selection, hover and focus are the theme foreground at low alpha. The one hue chrome uses is token:highlight (the theme's ANSI 4, usually blue), and only in agent pane composer controls: the Send fill, the pressed plan toggle (highlight at 16% with highlight text) and a switch's on state (Packages/Shared/CmuxTheme/Sources/CmuxTheme/ThemeTokens.swift:72 (ThemeTokens.highlight); webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/composerControls.css .acpmux-send, .acpmux-plan[aria-pressed=true], .acpmux-on .acpmux-switch). token:textSelection is the theme's selection-background, so it can be blue when the theme's is. Exception: group colors are user content and may be any of nine fixed hues, blue included (see groupColors).

input.description: ThemeInput: background, foreground, ANSI palette 0-15, selection-background/foreground (only when the config names a color), background-opacity (0-1), background-blur (0 off, >0 radius, <0 macOS glass). Read from the Ghostty config; cmux appearance.theme overrides theme = after the config files.

defaultTheme.value: light:Apple System Colors Light,dark:Apple System Colors

input.lightDark: isDark = luminance(background) < luminance(foreground) (Packages/Shared/CmuxTheme/Sources/CmuxTheme/ThemeTokens.swift:104 (ThemeTokens.derive)). The app light/dark appearance picks the light: or dark: half of the theme spec.

textPrimary.value: readable(fg, over(pressedFill,bg), 4.5): fg pushed toward white (surface lum<0.18) or black in 0.02 steps until 4.5:1

textSecondary.value: muted(textPrimary toward bg, up to 0.38, keeping 4.5:1 over over(pressedFill,bg)); steps of 0.01

textTertiary.value: muted(textPrimary toward bg, up to 0.55, keeping 3:1)

separator.value: alpha(fg, dark ? 0.08 : 0.07); clear when appearance.borders = none

paneBorder.value: alpha(fg, dark ? 0.07 : 0.09); clear when appearance.borders = none

focusRing.value: alpha(fg, 0.40). The pane ring replaces the alpha with focusRing.contrast (see components.panes.focusRing)

textSelection.value: selection-background if set, else mix(bg, fg, 0.22)

highlightText.value: bg or textPrimary (opaque), whichever contrasts more with highlight, if >= 4.5; else black or white

pageBackground.value: opaque contentBackground (browser page before first paint, error pages)

scopes.description: ThemeScope: app (Ghostty config), room, workspace and terminal themes. A view applies tokens of its own scope inside performWithTheme; a pane's chrome takes the terminal theme it shows. Tokens outside a scope are dynamic app-theme colors.

windowBackdrop.description: background-opacity < 1 and blur >= 0: window is translucent, CGS blur radius applied, panes do not paint their own background. background-blur < 0: macOS glass style. Opaque otherwise.

groupColors.description: The nine group colors shared by tab groups and workspace groups. User content, so this is the one fixed palette in chrome and the one place blue may appear outside the theme. Each is one hue at low saturation so groups stay calm next to the gray chrome. New groups never get blue automatically (TabGroupOrdering.nextColor skips it).
groupColors.huesFormat: [hue degrees, relative chroma]; grey has no chroma
groupColors.swatch: HSB(hue, saturation light 0.42 / dark 0.40 x chroma, brightness light 0.64 / dark 0.68): swatches, group underline, sidebar group dot, tab icon tint, profile dot
groupColors.fill: HSB(hue, saturation light 0.30 / dark 0.34 x chroma, brightness light 0.86 / dark 0.40): tab group chip; hover blends 8% textPrimary, pressed 16%
groupColors.wash: alpha(swatch, 0.09): band behind a group's tabs
groupColors.sidebarGroupHeader: drop target: alpha(swatch, 0.16) (grey: token:selectionFill); hover token:hoverFill; color dot filled when expanded, 1.5 pt ring when collapsed
groupColors.appearance: light/dark picks by the view's appearance (darkAqua vs aqua), not by the terminal theme

appleSystemDark.name: Apple System Colors (cmux default, dark appearance)

appleSystemLight.name: Apple System Colors Light (cmux default, light appearance)

ghosttyDefault.name: Ghostty built-in default (ThemeInput.ghosttyDefault, used until the config is read)

typography.family: SF Pro (NSFont.systemFont); monospaced chips use SF Mono (monospacedSystemFont). Web ports: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text' / ui-monospace, 'SF Mono'.
typography.lineHeight: AppKit default line height for the font (no explicit line spacing in chrome). SF Pro 12pt ~ 15pt, 13pt ~ 16pt (ascender+descender+leading of NSFont). Ports must measure, not assume CSS normal.

metrics.corners: See conventions.corners: continuous for chrome pills and buttons, circular for panes and palette rows.

overlay.select: Reduce Transparency -> opaque; macOS >= 26 -> liquidGlass (NSGlassEffectView .regular, tint token:glassTint); else vibrancy (NSVisualEffectView .popover, withinWindow, tint view token:glassTint, 1/scale border token:separator)
overlay.appliesTo: Every floating glass surface: palette, its actions menu and shortcut recorder, hover cards, browser find bar, prompt bar and notices (Glass.makeOverlayPanel), drop overlay, drop highlight, sticky column backdrop, refusal HUD (OverlaySurfaceView)
overlay.liveUpdate: One NSWorkspace accessibility observer switches every live surface; a theme scope repaint recolors the fallback.
overlay.olderMacOS: The vibrancy branch cannot run in the macOS app today: Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Package.swift requires macOS 26. Ports without Liquid Glass use vibrancy where the platform has a blur, else the opaque fallback.

opaqueFallback.value: mix(opaque windowBackground, opaque textPrimary, 0.14) with 1/scale border opaque separator

glassTintStrength.appliesTo: OverlaySurface surfaces (materials.overlay.appliesTo). Raw Glass.makePanel panels use token:glassTint unscaled.

stripBackdrop.value: ChromeBackdropView: NSVisualEffectView .headerView, behindWindow, with the strip tint over it at 0.82 x its alpha (defaultTintOpacity). The blur shows only in a see-through window with Reduce Transparency off; otherwise the tint is solid. Hidden unless tabBarBackground=darker or the pane theme differs from the window.

move.use: Tab reflow and reorder, sidebar row moves, pane and divider frames

appear.use: Palette scale-in, tab grow-in, group expand, row insert, sidebar show

disappear.use: Tab close, group collapse, row removal, sidebar hide

scroll.use: Strip reveal, column reveal, fling snap

track.use: Drop-zone overlay and drag ghost between targets

springModel.value: omega = 2*pi/response; stiffness = omega^2; damping = 2*dampingFraction*omega; semi-implicit Euler at 1/480 s (SwiftUI .spring(response:dampingFraction:) equivalent)

hover.use: Hover fills, hover-revealed buttons, divider hover

focus.use: Pane focus ring and inactive dim

fadeIn.use: Palette, find bar, notices, hover card appear

fadeOut.use: Palette close, find bar, notices, hover card hide

crossfade.use: Hover card thumbnail swap; Reduce Motion ceiling

reduceMotion.value: No movement springs, no loops; fades capped at crossfade (0.1 s). Speed off disables fades too.

value.effect: none clears every border, hairline and separator, disables the focus ring and attention width, and removes the omnibar editing ring (Metrics.lineWidth); focusIndicator=border then falls back to inactive dim. Target: the agent pane also draws no edge; today its composer, menu and code block edges (--acpmux-composer-edge, --cv-codeblock-ring) are not tied to the setting. Code fix in progress in a separate lane.

value.note: Debug Settings tunable only (no cmux.json key yet)
cmux.json key sidebar.sectionLook. The Debug Settings tunable sidebar.sections.look overrides it.

sidebar.topBandMaxShare / bottomBandMaxS.effect: Share of the sidebar height the sticky band above (below) the list takes before it scrolls inside; with stickyBandsScroll false the bands never scroll and the list shrinks (to three rows minimum).

notifications.attention.*.timing: blink: blinkCount blinks over flash/2 x blinkCount (0.6 s for 2 at speed fast), then rests at 1 when persist. pulse: opacity 1 -> 0.3 (easeInEaseOut, period loop.pulse 1.8 s) for duration (3 s). steady: fadeIn. Reduce Motion: one fadeIn.

appearance.statusIndicator.*.note: cmux.json keys: style, size (glyph share of the slot, 0.5-1.5), thickness (0.5-4 pt), color. The model field is StatusIndicatorSettings.scale.

sidebar.workspaceRow.description: A workspace row in the sidebar list. Text-first, fills only, no borders.

titleFade.value: space6 (16) edge fade on clipped titles

hover.closeButton: shown, replaces badge; title narrows then marquees
hover.marquee: starts after motion.marquee.delay (not under Reduce Motion)

background.value: token:selectionFill on a shared pill that glides between rows (spring selection)

gap.value: token:hoverFill gap pill at the insertion point

states.pressed: no distinct state (selection changes on mouse down)
states.focused(keyboard): no ring; keyboard selection moves the pill

shadow.value: token:shadow, opacity 0.28 lifted, radius space5 (12), offset y space3 (6); resting opacity 0 radius space2 offset space1

stack.value: back cards alpha(elevatedBackground,0.85) inset space2*depth, 0.5pt border token:separator

states.unfocusedWindow: no change (only the system traffic lights dim)

sidebar.statusIndicator.description: Shared status indicator (StatusIndicatorLayer) for sidebar rows, section headers and tabs: arc, native spinner, dot, progress ring, check.

metrics.slot: smallIconSize - space1 (10/12) in rows; icon frame inset space1 in tabs

states.busy: arc spinning (loop.spinner 0.9 s) in token:textSecondary (or appearance.statusIndicator.color); with progress a ring over a 0.22 track
states.reduceMotion: no spin or pulse; static glyphs

chevron.value: token:textTertiary, SF Symbol pt smallIconSize-space2 bold

sidebar.sectionItem.description: Sticky section items (Home, Settings, Account). The look picks headers and lines; each section's arrangement (list, inline, grid) picks how items flow.

icon.value: token:textSecondary (token:textOnPrimary on a colored list chip)

fill.value: none; tray tile: token:hoverFill at rest

sidebar.sectionLook.card: headers, sections on cards filled token:hoverFill, no lines
sidebar.sectionLook.tray: headers, built-in items as a grid of tiles on token:hoverFill, no lines
sidebar.sectionLook.lines: no headers, a line between sections
sidebar.sectionLook.linesIcons: no headers, lines, built-in items as icon-only buttons

arrangements.list: one row per item: icon and label (default)
arrangements.inline: items side by side as chips (icon + label, no badge, pill = chip bounds, glyph at space2, label space2 after it; width space2 + iconBox + space2 + label + 2*space2); icons only when labels do not fit; a second line only when icons do not fit
arrangements.grid: tiles in columns (align fill stretches them; columns nil = as many as fit at tileMinWidth)
arrangements.forcedByLook: tray forces built-in sections into a grid of tiles; linesIcons forces them inline, icons only

tabs.strip.description: Every pane has a tab strip. Strip edges are the content border edges.

metrics.height: tabStripHeight (28/36); resolved = pillTop + tabHeight + tabGap with pane padding

states.hover: trailing buttons reveal while the pointer is in the strip (TabStripButtonReveal)

appearance.tabBarBackground.window: strip = window background, no fill layer

metrics.backgroundInset: tabBackgroundInset (1): the pill starts at x=0 in its slot and is 2*inset narrower, so the 2 pt gap is all on the trailing side (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextTabs/TabStripMetrics.swift:98-100 (TabStripMetrics.pillFrame))

default(unselected).icon: tinted like the title; dormant opacity 0.55

states.pressed: no distinct tab fill (selection on mouse down)

fill.value: token:separator, height tabHeight/2, centered in the gap, shown between unselected neighbours

shadow.value: token:shadow opacity 0.22, radius space3, offset y space1

status.running: shared StatusIndicatorLayer in the icon frame inset space1, replacing the icon; follows appearance.statusIndicator (style, size, thickness 1.5, color token:textSecondary); progress shows a ring, paused uses token:attention (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextTabs/TabCell+StatusIndicator.swift:10-35 (TabCell.spinnerPlan, updateSpinner))

tabs.inactivePaneEmphasis.description: How an unfocused pane's tabs draw subtler when focusIndicator marks tabs and the screen has >1 pane.

focus.inactiveTabStyle.fade: text tiers mixed toward the page by strength until contrast floors; selectionFill and hoverFill alpha *(1-strength)
focus.inactiveTabStyle.tonal: primary<-secondary, secondary<-tertiary, tertiary faded strength/2; selectionFill = hoverFill alpha *(1-strength/2)
focus.inactiveTabStyle.quiet: primary<-secondary, secondary/tertiary faded strength/2; selectionFill transparent

metrics.thumbnail: tabMaxWidth x round(tabMaxWidth*10/16), radius itemCornerRadius, placeholder token:hoverFill

metrics.offset: space2 below or beside the anchor, space2 screen margin

overlays.hoverCardPanel.material: Glass panel, tint token:glassTint. The materials.overlay fallbacks (opaque under Reduce Transparency), through Glass.makeOverlayPanel.

border.value: token:paneBorder hairline, shown when no ring/attention draws

dim.value: opaque token:contentBackground at opacity 0.14, only when dimsInactivePanes or (borders none and focusIndicator border)

ring.value: token:attention (or notification color), width 2; blink: 2 blinks over 0.6 s (loop.flash), then persists. See settings.notifications.attention.*.timing

states.shown: focused pane, >1 pane (or showWhenSinglePane), focusIndicator border|both, borders default

color.value: focusRing.color ?? alpha(fg, contrast) where contrast subtle 0.20 / standard 0.55 / strong 0.85

metrics.keycap: iconSize+space2 square min, radius itemCornerRadius-space1, gap space1

typography.title: body (matched chars bodyEmphasized textPrimary; others alpha(textPrimary,0.78) while filtering)
typography.subtitle: caption textSecondary

panel.material: Glass .regular tint token:glassTint. The materials.overlay fallbacks (opaque under Reduce Transparency); PaletteContentView.glass is Glass.makeOverlayPanel.
panel.rules: token:separator above and below the list

shadow.value: alpha(token:shadow,0.22), blur space6+space4 (24), offset y space4 (8)

palette.panel.shape: panel continuous (glass); rows, keycaps and actions-menu rows are circular arcs (NSBezierPath roundedRect)

metrics.note: Bar, button, chip, card and row radii are fixed points, not density tokens.

typography.url: compact URL: host token:textPrimary, rest token:textSecondary

agentPane.description: Web UI (React) themed by the native bridge (AgentPaneTheme.swift).

bridge.--agent-page-bg: contentBackground (transparent when the window is translucent)

metrics.userBubble: max-width 70%, padding 10.5px 16px 9.5px, radius 16px, fill text 5% (.cv-user__bubble, conversation.css:58-62)

states.focusVisible: composer picker, plan and Send: 1.5px solid text, offset 2px; rail buttons and sidebar actions: 2px text 40%, offset -2px; session rows: 2px accent (= text), offset -2px; diff tools and file headers: 1.5px muted, offset 1px

agentPane.timestamps: Turn footer: 'Worked for Ns', copy icon, time; color --cv-text-dim (textTertiary), tabular numbers (webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/conversation/conversation.css:659-669)
agentPane.bordersNone: Target: no edge anywhere. The bridge clears --agent-border and --agent-border-strong; the composer edge (--acpmux-composer-edge, 0.5px inset text 18%), menu edges and code block ring (--cv-codeblock-ring) still draw today. Code fix in progress in a separate lane.

tabs.groups.description: Tab group chip, underline and wash. Colors: theme.groupColors.

states.chip: groupColor.fill; hover +8% textPrimary, pressed +16%; name token:textPrimary, count token:textSecondary; shadow token:shadow radius space3 y space1
